channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: ICC Rules Ex-Philippine President Duterte Fit for Trial
item.description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has ruled that former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte is fit to stand trial. The ICC judges made this determination regarding the charges against him. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Sanctions Fiji-Based Man Over Corruption Linked to China
item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on a Fiji-based individual, alleging corruption linked to China. The U.S. stated that this official paid bribes on behalf of Beijing. The sanctions target an individual operating out of Fiji, with… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: California Woman Accused of Spying for China to Remain Detained
item.description: A woman in California, accused of spying for China, will be detained while awaiting trial. She had proposed an $820,000 security to fight her detention. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Curtis Flowers, Wrongfully Convicted Man, Dies at 56
item.description: Curtis Flowers, a Black man who was tried six times for the same murders and whose conviction was eventually overturned after 22 years in prison, has died at the age of 56. He was from Mississippi. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Wells Fargo Probed Over Black Homeownership Program
item.description: Wells Fargo is facing an investigation by regulators concerning its efforts to increase Black homeownership. The probe is examining the bank's program designed to boost Black homeownership. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Teen Charged in Alleged Mall Shooting Plot
item.description: A teenager in the United States has been charged in connection with an alleged plot to carry out a shooting at a mall, reportedly inspired by the Daesh (ISIS) group. The specific location of the mall was not detailed in the coverage. In a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Guilfoyle Accused of Asking Donor for $100K Amex Payment; Vance, Rubio Decline Comment
item.description: An accusation has surfaced that Kimberly Guilfoyle requested a donor to pay a $100,000 American Express bill. Senators J.D. Vance and Marco Rubio have both declined to comment on the allegations. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: ICE Acquires US Army-Rejected Shock Gloves for Border Patrol
item.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is acquiring electric shock gloves that a US Army study found caused excessive pain, compliance, and fear. The Army had deemed the gloves too painful for its own use. ICE's acquisition of these… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Southampton Manager Receives Suspended Ban in Spygate Scandal
item.description: Southampton manager Tonda Eckert has been handed a suspended ban by the Football Association (FA) in relation to the Spygate scandal. Eckert spoke publicly after the FA announced the punishment. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Shark attack survivor recounts predator 'winking' during struggle
item.description: Mel Ismail, a survivor of a shark attack, has shared details of his encounter, stating the predator 'winked' at him as he fought it off. The attack involved a great white shark biting his leg. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Fatally Shot at Memorial Service in West London
item.description: A man was fatally shot at a memorial service in west London. The incident occurred in front of children. The first image of the victim has been released. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cornell University Faces Scrutiny Over Sexual Violence Allegations
item.description: Cornell University is facing renewed debate regarding sexual violence on its campuses following unspecified allegations. The nature of these allegations and the specific details of the events have not been detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mexico trial verdict nears for men accused of killing surfers
item.description: A verdict is expected Friday in Mexico for three men accused of killing Australian brothers. The surfers were reportedly killed in Mexico. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: France suspends stun grenades after protester loses hand
item.description: France has suspended the use of stun grenades by police following an incident where a student protester lost a hand. The National Herald suggested this could serve as a lesson for India. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Army Psychiatrist Nidal Hasan Faces Execution
item.description: Former US Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan is set to face execution, which will be livestreamed. The execution is being carried out by the US Army. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Drones Strike Major Russian AI Company Data Center
item.description: Ukrainian drones are believed to have struck a major data center owned by a leading Russian AI company, identified as Yandex. This marks what is described as the first major attack on a Russian data hub. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Rebukes Centre Over Disabled Cadets' Benefits
item.description: The Supreme Court has rebuked the Central government for its non-compliance with a previous order concerning benefits for disabled officer cadets. The court questioned the government's "scant attitude to court" in implementing the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Allahabad High Court Criticizes UP Police Over Noida Incident
item.description: The Allahabad High Court has strongly criticized the Uttar Pradesh police, describing their condition as "a mess" and stating that "they think they can do anything, get away." The court's remarks were made orally, rebuking Noida police in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: PDP Leader Detained for Calling Terrorist Burhan Wani a 'Martyr'
item.description: Abdul Kabir, a senior leader of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) in Jammu and Kashmir, has been detained. Kabir referred to Hizbul Mujahideen terrorist Burhan Wani as a "martyr" during a speech at an event. The detention occurred… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Metro Gates May Close for October 10 Protest
item.description: Ahead of a planned protest on October 10, Delhi Police have requested the closure of entry and exit gates at 57 Delhi Metro stations. Senior police officials stated that these restrictions, covering stations across all parts of Delhi… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: High Court Questions Use of 'Andolanjeevi' in Journalist's NSA Detention
item.description: The Allahabad High Court questioned the use of the term 'andolanjeevi' in the grounds for the detention of a journalist under the National Security Act (NSA). The court's query arose during proceedings related to a protest by workers in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Teacher Suspended for Playing Tabla on Student's Head in UP School
item.description: A video circulating on social media shows a teacher, identified as in-charge headmaster Dinesh Kumar Mathur, at the primary school Birouli in Saifai block, Etawah district, Uttar Pradesh, appearing to play a tabla on a child's nearly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Wife Allegedly Mutilates Husband's Genitals in Meerut
item.description: In Meerut, a woman named Shabnam allegedly drugged her husband, Nadeem, with a substance in his coffee after suspecting him of talking to other men. While he was unconscious, she reportedly attacked him with a knife, causing injuries to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Father Kills Wife and Daughter in Lucknow; Arrested
item.description: In Krishna Nagar, Lucknow, a double murder occurred where a father allegedly killed his wife and daughter. The accused, identified as a Home Guard named Ravindra Shankar, is alleged to have strangled his wife, Shyama Dulari, and daughter… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court hears plea on excluded voters, flags software issues
item.description: The Supreme Court is considering a plea that would allow voters excluded from electoral rolls to cast their ballots in civic polls in Bengal. Justices on the tribunal raised questions about the ECINET software, noting it lacks a facility… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Fire at IIT Bombay Hostel Injures Five, Including Two Children
item.description: A fire broke out in a hostel on the IIT Bombay campus following a gas leak, resulting in injuries to five people, including two children. The incident occurred in a hostel within the campus premises. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre proposes stricter rules for prescription drug advertising
item.description: The Central government has proposed stricter regulations for the advertising of prescription drugs by retailers and wholesalers. The Union Health Ministry is seeking to implement these tighter rules. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: OpenAI fires three researchers for policy violations
item.description: OpenAI has dismissed three researchers for allegedly violating the company's sensitive information policy. The company stated that the dismissals were not related to the researchers raising safety concerns or speaking out about them. One… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear plea challenging CEC, EC appointments
item.description: A fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court challenging the appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and two Election Commissioners (ECs). The petition also alleges that Justice Surya Kant, who was part of a bench… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Upholds High Court Order on Andhra Pradesh Backward Class Quota
item.description: The Supreme Court has dismissed a plea by the Andhra Pradesh government challenging a High Court order that struck down a 34% quota for Backward Classes (BC) in local body elections. The High Court had previously ruled against this… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Denies Delhi Police Free Hand Against Protesters
item.description: The Supreme Court has rejected a plea that sought to grant the Delhi Police a free hand in dealing with protesters. The court, in its observation, stated that the future of young students and their families should be considered in such… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: US Sanctions Indian Firms and Individuals Over Iran Oil Trade
item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on two Mumbai-based companies, SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited, and five Indian nationals associated with them. These actions are part of a broader US… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 4.

item.title: ICE agents shoot man in New York City with child present
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents shot a man in New York City while a 5-year-old child was present in the vehicle, according to Mayor Eric Adams. The incident occurred in Marble Hill. The mayor has vowed action and called… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: Fatal Shooting on Culver CityBus, Suspect at Large
item.description: A fatal shooting occurred on a Culver CityBus, according to a witness. The suspect is currently at large. The incident took place on Central Avenue. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sri Lankan Death-Row Prisoner Injured in Saudi Jail
item.description: Twenty‑four‑year‑old Sri Lankan Hindu migrant worker Anojan Sivarasa, who is on death row in Saudi Arabia after being sentenced for a Facebook comment, was injured in a physical altercation with a fellow inmate. Sri Lanka’s Foreign… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: US Suspends Tech Firms, Including Microsoft, From Green Card Program
item.description: The U.S. administration has suspended Microsoft, Infosys, TCS, Adobe, and Wipro, along with five other firms, from participating in the green card program. The New York Times reported the suspension of Microsoft from the green card… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 13 · Right 2.

item.title: FBI foils Mall of America terror plot, arrests suspect
item.description: The FBI has arrested a suspect accused of plotting a mass terror shooting at the Mall of America. According to the FBI, the suspect also planned to join ISIS. The FBI stated that agents sold the suspect an assault rifle as part of their… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US indicts Venezuela's Maduro and wife on torture charges
item.description: The United States has indicted former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife on charges related to an alleged torture conspiracy. The indictment, unsealed on an unspecified date, accuses the couple of involvement in the torture… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Building collapses in Delhi's Seemapuri, seven injured
item.description: A building collapsed in Delhi's Seemapuri area, resulting in seven injuries. Among the injured was a pregnant woman who, while trapped under the rubble, managed to call her family for water. She later died in the hospital. The cause of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Flydubai Jet Plunged 14,000 Feet in Under a Minute
item.description: A Flydubai passenger jet experienced a rapid descent, falling approximately 14,000 feet in about 30 seconds. The incident resulted in damage to the aircraft, attributed to extreme speeds, angles, and G-force loads. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 11 · Right 2.
